modules.title: Introduction to Jacob and Joseph
modules.html:
Jacob and his twelve sons; Joseph is sold into Egypt, rises to power there, and is reconciled with his brothers. This section covers introduction to jacob and joseph.

Key points

  • The primary reason why Joseph's brothers hated him was because _____. — he was his father's favorite.
  • Joseph was sold by his brothers to the Ishmaelites for _____ pieces of silver. — twenty.
  • Joseph sold to: — Ishmaelites.
  • Joseph was sold into slavery by his brothers for: — 20 pieces of silver.
  • Joseph was appointed governor in Egypt because: — He interpreted Pharaoh's dream.

Worked examples

Q: The primary reason why Joseph's brothers hated him was because _____.
A: he was his father's favorite — Genesis 37:3-4 states that because Israel loved Joseph more than all his other sons, the brothers hated him and could not speak peaceably to him.

Q: Joseph was sold by his brothers to the Ishmaelites for _____ pieces of silver.
A: twenty — According to Genesis 37:28, Joseph's brothers sold him to the Midianite/Ishmaelite traders for twenty shekels of silver.

examples.q: The primary reason why Joseph's brothers hated him was because _____.
Joseph was sold by his brothers to the Ishmaelites for _____ pieces of silver.
